notes.title: Hate Free Heroes 3.0 Now Here!
notes.content:
We have updated [b]Hate Free Heroes[/b] to 3.0 and added free access to [b]Hate Free Heroes Tactics[/b] for all players. Everyone who purchased or purchases the game will receive free access to [b]Hate Free Heroes Tactics[/b], access to our web browser mobile version and community for [b]Hate Free Heroes[/b] at no extra charge. Logging into the community will allow you to update your place on our leaderboards, update your profile, pictures and more.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/514540/Hate_Free_Heroes_RPG_30/

[h1]To claim Your Free Access[/h1]

If you purchased [b]Hate Free Heroes[/b] from Steam or have the game in your Steam inventory, you qualify to receive free access to our mobile version and [b]Hate Free Heroes Tactics[/b] online game. Simply post in this thread "hfh" and we'll send you your access codes and details. 

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/514540/eventcomments/2963890181158659841]Claim Your Free Access Here[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26545584/3ddd29c67deb5221bcd2abeb08ab478cbd6ed101.png[/img]

[h1]About Hate Free Heroes Tactics[/h1]

Hate Free Heroes Tactics is a community based online game and adventure. Help your city reduce aggro levels by building your agency, defeating aggromites and researching new ways of keeping city aggro levels at a minimum. Play from any web browser, PC, tablet or phone. Build your agency, upgrade your offices with equipment, hire agents to increase your resources, make medical advancements, research new advancements, complete missions, go out on the field and defeat aggromites, engage in cyber defense pvp, upgrade your character gear and so much more. Launch the game from any web browser, no downloads needed.

    Strategy Based Building Game, Turn Based, Character Building RPG
    Fully browser based. Play from any system, phone, tablet or PC
    Community chat, agency and global rankings
    Upgrade your agency base with equipment to earn resources
    Engage in Cyber Defense PVP and build your PVP Rank
    Explore the city and defeat aggromites
    Level up your character (Level Max +120)
    Buy gear and upgrade your character equipment
    Complete research and medical advancements
    Earn in game achievements to earn meta crystals
    Complete Quests and Missions
    Join or create your own agency branch and earn experience
    Compete for ranking and climb the ranks
    Countless hours of gameplay
    and so much more...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26545584/e558bb647d200cb0720b4eac173f3bd68a15406d.png[/img]

notes.title: King of Crowns Chess Online
notes.content:
We will be launching King of Crowns Chess Online via Steam on March 27, 2018. Our new chess game has a unique card system that lets you earn in game cards that you can collect and trade in for card points. New look and design, new game boards, chess pieces and more. Some of the game features include:

1.  Earn in game Card Packs and collect Cards to earn Card points.
2. Unique score system to create total score: Mastery Score, Seniority Score, Elo Score and Card Points.
3. Earn Rank Badges and Trophies. Global and Club Ranking System.
4. Select from 4 Clubs levels to join with chat box for each club.
5. Earn Steam Trading Cards.

Remember to join us March 27th and join me personally in an online match.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/576690/King_of_Crowns_Chess_Online/

notes.title: Hate Free Heroes is Coming! VOTE!
notes.content:
We've been in production of our upcoming RPG for almost a year now along with Angels of Fasaria 3.0 which is looking very promising as well. We will soon open a round table to discuss the game and it's future and have sign ups for a small team of testers.

You can find the link to our website below and also follow us on facebook, twitter and join our Steam group as well.

http://hatefreeheroes.com
http://steamcommunity.com/groups/hatefreeheroes
https://www.facebook.com/hatefreeheroesfans
https://mobile.twitter.com/HateFreeHeroes

We need your help to get it on steam! Please remember to vote so we can get the wheels of this game going.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=701242766
[B]About Hate Free Heroes:[/B]

Hate Free Heroes is a modern day role playing game that takes the player into the role of an H.F.H agent and researcher dedicated to decreasing the rise of "Aggromites" in the city.
 
Aggromites/Aggromite (definition) [ag-roh-myht] [noun]: A mischievous entity that influence a person's aggression levels through the "dream world" or altered reality.
 
Join the H.F.H agency, complete major missions and research missions to help the agency discover the reason behind the growing rise in "Aggro". Journey through the city of Newsport to find faithful agents that will join your cause as you begin to unravel the mystery behind the "Aggromite" influx.

• Explore the Large City of Newsport 
• Major Missions and Research Missions to Complete 
• Upgradeable Gear with Gear Slots 
• Steam Achievements 
• Steam Trading Cards

notes.title: February Newsletter: A Lot of Updates Coming!
notes.content:
We have a lot of major updates on the way for all of our games so keep a look out.

[h1][b]Fasaria World Online:[/b][/h1]

A lot of major changes to the game and a major overhaul of some features are in the works, expect to see a full update to the game very soon.

[h1][b]Angels of Fasaria RPG:[/b][/h1]

We are working on a new version of Angels of Fasaria RPG from the ground up. This new version will be released as a stand alone game and it is TOTALLY different in comparison from the current version. A lot of major changes and improvements will be included to this newer version so it will be sold as a new game. We are still considering creating a browser based mmo to accompany that version but no absolute decision has been made yet.

[h1][b]Angels of Fasaria Online:[/b][/h1]

We still have sign ups open for alpha testing for the online game version of Angels of Fasaria. Not a lot of people have signed up or shown interest so development is currently halted. If you want to see the online game be made, sign up and show your support for it. Currently, you can sign up on steam but private testing may occur which will require an NDA and participation will be outside of steam until the game is ready for beta testing.

[h1][b]AoF Chess Club 2.0:[/b][/h1]

Some nice updates are scheduled for AoF Chess Club 2.0, mainly the translated versions which should open the community to players from around the world. More info soon.

[h1][b]AoF World Online:[/b][/h1]

We have a community edition in the works which will include the server with scripts for all players to be able to launch and play locally on their computer. We will also open up the workshop giving players freedom to edit and submit their modified versions. This should open this game to the community for further development and growth as we are no longer developing this game.

The partner dlc will allow players to host their own server where trial players will have access to play on for free. Active servers will have the opportunity to migrate to our list of servers reserved for paid players.

notes.title: NSE Circuit November Newsletter
notes.content:
Busy, busy, busy. We have a lot going on in November to talk about. Fasaria World Online is expected to release this month on November 5th and Ancients of Fasaria Chess Club on November 4th. Be sure to get the games if you haven't already. We've also just recently added a new web launcher for each game that makes accessing them from steam a snap. Here are some of the updates and changes to look out for.

Fasaria World Online Updates:

1. We have removed the ability to purchase crystals from our online shop and instead replaced it with an "Elite Sponsorship Package" option.

2. ALL players now will receive 50 crystonian crystals every month for free. Crystals have already been added to all accounts this month so log in and spend it!

Ancients of Fasaria Chess Club Updates:

1. We've added the ability to select up to 5 different chess piece styles and 5 different board colors.

2. We added a chat box for each club.

3. We added a match making lobby where you can now organize matches.

Angels of Fasaria 2.0 Updates:

We are still looking for players to volunteer for testing our upcoming mmo for Angels of Fasaria. If you have the game in your inventory, you qualify to join early testing so sign up on the discussion board.

That's all for now. We have a lot of more updates and good news coming soon, so always check in NSE Circuit for all your latest news and updates. 

http://nsecircuit.com

notes.title: Angels of Fasaria: Version 2.0 Release
notes.content:
After many user suggestions and complaints, we finally decided to do a full update of the RPG game keeping in mind all of the suggestions previously given to us by players. 

Angels of Fasaria is an older title that was supported by it's fans so we didn't want to change the core elements that players seemed to enjoy the most. We decided against doing a re-make of the game and have instead included all of the requested changes in this game so players can enjoy it now. You can play any saved game and the updates will apply to any of your games. It is advised that you start a new game if you want to experience all of the updates in it's entirety.

Version 2.0 Update Log:

1. Mana can now be earned each time you defeat an enemy instead of having to farm them from angels.
2. Enemies now vanish from the field after you defeat them.
3. A combat trainer has been added that will help you out early in the game.
4. Players start out with trainer armor, shield and angel ring (in treasure chest in your room)
5. Maps have been added for all continents. You start out with the first map after speaking with the king. Maps give you an overview of each continent.
6. Crafting cristonia is now easier granting you the ability to craft in bulk.
7. Some price adjustments to armor and weapons to make a little more affordable.
8. Companions now edited so that you only can select one companion per guild.

Discontinuing the Online Game:

We are currently removing the online game version for download and access. The game engine was just too unstable and the players too few to consider this a title worth including as a bundle. 

We are looking into developing a far better, fully stable and supported online game that when completed will be a stand alone title and not bundled. Mostly all of our players play the RPG and never get online. The instability of the mmo just took away from the all around game experience and is more of an annoyance than an asset. If we get a new online version completed, we expect to spend much time building the community and we'll be sure to give all current customers an opportunity to claim a free copy.

notes.title: Experience Update for Online Game
notes.content: The online game has been updated to provide a smother leveling up experience that feels less of a grind. You'll lever up faster at lower levels and more progressively at higher levels. Upgrading your character stats is a lot less of a chore. Expect an all around better game experience this way. Level cap has been increased to 110 as well.

notes.title: Game Update 1.0
notes.content:
We've made some updates to AoF to help players get a better head start in the game.

1. More weapons and armor can be found and now at a cheaper rate when speaking to the King's helper.  

2, Quests have been added earlier in the game. You can complete quests by speaking to the hand maiden next to the Queen.

3. Spawn rate of enemies has been decreased a bit to give more flexibility of movement through out the world.
